scenarios.title: Deferred paint colour selection
scenarios.scope: Late confirmation of wall and ceiling paint colours where the paint system, coats and areas are unchanged and work has not yet commenced.
scenarios.materiality_note: Same product and labour; only tint base differs.
scenarios.research_need: Whether deep tint bases or repainting of completed work is involved.

scenarios.title: Retaining wall construction
scenarios.scope: Construct retaining wall up to 3m retained height including excavation, foundation, wall structure, drainage layer, backfill and surface finish, excluding specific engineering design.
scenarios.materiality_note: Structural element with foundation, drainage and backfill costs
merges: retaining wall construction with fire rating
scenarios.research_need: Wall type, retained height, surcharge, foundation conditions, drainage and consent requirements

scenarios.title: Channel drain installation to paving
scenarios.scope: Supply and install proprietary polymer/concrete channel drain with grate to trafficable or footpath paving, including concrete haunching and connection to nearest stormwater line, per metre of run.
scenarios.materiality_note: Grate class, haunching and connection drive real cost per metre
scenarios.research_need: Channel/grate load class rates, haunch concrete quantity, connection depth and paving reinstatement

scenarios.title: Suspended tile ceiling supply install
scenarios.scope: Supply and install exposed-grid suspended ceiling with mineral fibre or similar lay-in tiles, including hangers and seismic bracing, to regular open ceiling areas.
scenarios.materiality_note: Grid, tile and seismic hanger labour are substantial per m2.
merges: suspended ceiling tile supply and install
scenarios.research_need: Tile type/NRC, grid system, ceiling height and seismic restraint standard.

scenarios.title: Mains and feeder cable installation
scenarios.scope: Supply and install main incoming and sub-main feeder cables with containment and terminations between switchboards, priced per metre of installed run.
scenarios.materiality_note: Copper cable and containment are major cost drivers
scenarios.research_need: Cable size and type, route length, containment, termination and copper price basis

scenarios.title: Resin floor colour selection
scenarios.scope: Late nomination of colour, pigment or flake blend for an otherwise specified resin/epoxy floor coating where the system, thickness and application remain unchanged.
scenarios.materiality_note: Same system and labour; only pigment differs unless bespoke.
scenarios.research_need: Whether standard colour range applies or bespoke tint/flake attracts supplier premium.

scenarios.title: Internal doorset supply and install
scenarios.scope: Supply and install a single internal door leaf with frame, hung and adjusted, priced per leaf type, frame material and opening height, excluding hardware and vision panels.
scenarios.materiality_note: Fire rating, frame material and leaf core drive large rate swings
merges: door frame and opening height selection
supply and install door leaf and frame
scenarios.research_need: Rates by leaf core, fire/acoustic rating, timber vs steel frame, opening height

scenarios.title: Solar array mounting structural support
scenarios.scope: Structural design, supply and installation of roof or ground mounting support for a solar PV array, including purlin or rafter strengthening and fixings, excluding electrical work.
scenarios.materiality_note: Engineering plus roof strengthening across whole array is costly
scenarios.research_need: Array size and weight, roof structure capacity, strengthening extent, PS1 fee

scenarios.title: Aluminium composite panel cladding
scenarios.scope: Supply and fix aluminium composite or sheet wall cladding on existing framing/substrate up to 10m height, including fixings, subgirts and standard flashings, measured by cladding face area.
scenarios.materiality_note: Panel supply, subframe and access drive substantial cost
scenarios.research_need: Panel system rates, subgirt spacing, access method and flashing extent per m2

scenarios.title: Switchboard fault rating and protection
scenarios.scope: Fault level assessment, busbar bracing upgrade and supply/installation of correctly rated protection devices to an existing or new switchboard.
scenarios.materiality_note: High-rated breakers and busbar work are costly
merges: electrical protection device sizing and installation
switchboard busbar and fault rating installation
scenarios.research_need: Prospective fault current, breaker kA ratings, discrimination study and design fees

scenarios.title: Solar connection switchboard works
scenarios.scope: Switchboard and distribution board works for PV grid connection including solar supply switch, dedicated solar board and associated upgrade of existing boards.
scenarios.materiality_note: Board modifications and isolation gear carry real cost
scenarios.research_need: Inverter capacity, board modification extent, export limits and network approval

scenarios.title: Facade and soffit coating
scenarios.scope: Prepare and apply two-coat exterior coating system to plastered, concrete, steel panel or soffit surfaces up to 10m height, including access, measured by coated area.
scenarios.materiality_note: Preparation, coats and external access are real labour cost
scenarios.research_need: Coating system spec, substrate prep, number of coats and access type

scenarios.title: Glazed vision panel to door
scenarios.scope: Cut, frame and glaze a vision panel into a door leaf, including beads and glass to rating, priced per panel up to 300x900mm.
scenarios.materiality_note: Leaf modification and fire-rated glass carry real cost
merges: supply and install glazed vision panel
scenarios.research_need: Factory versus site cut cost, fire-rated glazing rates, leaf rating impact

scenarios.title: Site establishment and compound relocation
scenarios.scope: Relocating or reconfiguring temporary site fencing, sheds, stockpile and material storage areas within an operating construction site, excluding new hardstand construction.
scenarios.materiality_note: Plant, labour and downtime costs, but no permanent works
merges: relocate site fencing and stockpile areas
scenarios.research_need: Fence length, shed size, crane/hiab needs, number of moves, standing time rates

scenarios.title: Door hardware set installation
scenarios.scope: Supply and install ironmongery per leaf - locksets, closers, security and roller door hardware - fitted to an already hung door, excluding access control wiring.
scenarios.materiality_note: Hardware set value ranges widely; fitting labour per leaf
scenarios.research_need: Rates for standard, security and closer sets by grade and finish

scenarios.title: External concrete paving and slabs
scenarios.scope: Construct reinforced concrete external paving or yard slab on prepared subbase, including formwork, mesh, falls to design levels, joints and finish, up to 200mm thick.
scenarios.materiality_note: Concrete, reinforcement, formwork and finishing all measurable cost
scenarios.research_need: Slab thickness, reinforcement, subbase depth, surface finish, joint layout and area size

scenarios.title: Metering and control wiring installation
scenarios.scope: Install and terminate small-gauge control, instrumentation and monitoring cabling to water meters, irrigation controllers and field devices, including containment within a site.
scenarios.materiality_note: Modest cable cost but recurring termination and testing labour
scenarios.research_need: Cable type, run lengths, termination counts and BMS interface points

scenarios.title: Garden bed planting installation
scenarios.scope: Supply and planting of trees, shrubs and groundcover into prepared garden beds including topsoil, staking and establishment period, excluding turf, mulch and irrigation.
scenarios.materiality_note: Plant supply, grades and maintenance period carry real cost.
merges: plant and shrub planting supply and installation
scenarios.research_need: Species schedule, plant grades, densities, topsoil depth and maintenance period length.

scenarios.title: Structural steel connection fabrication upgrades
scenarios.scope: Fabrication and installation of revised or added steel connections - cleats, brackets, weld plates, bolted and welded joints - on members already in the contract, priced per connection.
scenarios.materiality_note: Engineering, shop fabrication and site welding add real cost
merges: structural steel connection detailing and fabrication
structural steel bracket fabrication and installation
scenarios.research_need: Connection type, plate/weld size, shop versus site work, inspection requirements

scenarios.title: Glass splashback supply install
scenarios.scope: Supply and install toughened back-painted glass or tiled splashback to kitchen and kitchenette benches, including templating, cutouts for services and silicone fixing.
scenarios.materiality_note: Toughened glass, templating and cutouts carry real cost.
scenarios.research_need: Glass type/colour, panel sizes, number of cutouts and wall substrate.

scenarios.title: Internal stud partition wall construction
scenarios.scope: Supply and erect steel or timber stud partitions to a documented wall type, including plasterboard both faces, insulation, stopping ready for decoration, floor to underside of ceiling or slab.
scenarios.materiality_note: Framing, board, insulation and stopping labour per square metre.
merges: construct wall to documented wall type
scenarios.research_need: Wall type build-up, height, fire/acoustic rating and stopping level required.

scenarios.title: Deflection head and acoustic seal
scenarios.scope: Form head-of-wall deflection detail to timber or steel framed partitions with compressible acoustic seal and slip track, measured per linear metre of wall head.
scenarios.materiality_note: Proprietary track, seal and fire/acoustic testing add cost
merges: deflection head detailing for timber framing
scenarios.research_need: Deflection allowance, acoustic/fire rating and proprietary head track system

scenarios.title: Benchtop and laminate panel
scenarios.scope: Supply and install benchtops and compact laminate panels to existing cabinetry or framing, including cutouts and edging, priced per lineal metre of run.
scenarios.materiality_note: Substrate choice between laminate and stone shifts rate sharply
scenarios.research_need: Rates by benchtop material, thickness, edge detail and cutout count

scenarios.title: Network supply connection and metering
scenarios.scope: Lines-company supply point connection, HV/LV metering unit installation and configuration including network fees, coordination and energisation for one connection.
scenarios.materiality_note: Network fees and metering units are large lump costs
merges: hv metering unit installation and configuration
scenarios.research_need: Network operator fee schedule, metering CT class, connection lead times

scenarios.title: Fire sprinkler system installation
scenarios.scope: Supply and install wet pipe sprinkler system to an existing approved design within a single building, including pipework, heads, valve set and commissioning, excluding pump, tank and hydraulic design.
scenarios.materiality_note: Full reticulated system, significant pipework and labour cost
merges: fire sprinkler system installation to design
scenarios.research_need: NZS 4541 head spacing, hazard class, per m2 sprinkler rates by building type

scenarios.title: Interior finishes to schedule
scenarios.scope: Supply and install of miscellaneous interior finishes nominated on a finishes schedule not covered by a dedicated trade, including wall, floor and feature finishes in fitout areas.
scenarios.materiality_note: Scope breadth means variable but generally real cost.
scenarios.research_need: Finishes schedule items, quantities and which trades are already covered.

scenarios.title: Subgrade preparation and basecourse replacement
scenarios.scope: Undercut of unsuitable subgrade, disposal and replacement with compacted GAP40/65 basecourse to 300mm, in trafficked pavement or slab areas.
scenarios.materiality_note: Cart, disposal and aggregate supply are all priced quantities
scenarios.research_need: GAP supply and cart rates, disposal costs and undercut depth assumptions

scenarios.title: Industrial roller and specialist doors
scenarios.scope: Supply and install industrial door units - roller, roller shutter, high speed or specialist - up to 5x5m opening including tracks, motor and commissioning, excluding structural opening works.
scenarios.materiality_note: Unit and motor costs are major; wide rate spread by type
merges: supply and install roller shutter door
supply and install high speed door
scenarios.research_need: Rates by door type, opening size, motorisation and cycle speed

scenarios.title: Joinery finishing and painting
scenarios.scope: Prepare, prime and finish coat site or factory joinery surfaces, priced per m2, covering paint, stain or clear lacquer systems on standard substrates.
scenarios.materiality_note: Finish system change matters; like-for-like colour change does not
scenarios.research_need: Rates per m2 for paint, stain and lacquer systems, factory versus site

scenarios.title: Emergency lighting and exit signage
scenarios.scope: Supply, install and test maintained emergency luminaires and exit sign fittings including circuit wiring and AS/NZS 2293 discharge testing certification.
scenarios.materiality_note: Fitting counts and compliance testing drive real cost
merges: exit sign fitting supply and install
scenarios.research_need: Fitting type and count, wiring runs, 90-minute test and certification cost

scenarios.title: Site electrical reticulation and services
scenarios.scope: Installation of site-wide electrical reticulation, services layout equipment, pits, conduits and general electrical services fitout across an external site area.
scenarios.materiality_note: Broad scope with trenching, conduit and equipment quantities
merges: install site services layout and equipment
site services layout and equipment installation
scenarios.research_need: Reticulation route lengths, conduit sizes, pit counts and excavation interface

scenarios.title: Data rack and network hardware
scenarios.scope: Supply and install communications rack, patch panels, network switches and rack-terminated structured cabling for one comms room or cabinet.
scenarios.materiality_note: Active hardware and rack fitout are high value
merges: install data rack and network switches
scenarios.research_need: Rack size, port counts, switch specification and cable certification testing

scenarios.title: Perimeter security fencing supply install
scenarios.scope: Supply and installation of site perimeter fencing (mesh or steel palisade up to 2.4m high) on level ground including posts, footings and pedestrian access gates, excluding vehicle gates and automation.
scenarios.materiality_note: Long runs, posts and footings; significant material and labour cost.
merges: security fence and access gate installation
temporary and permanent site fencing installation
scenarios.research_need: Fence type, height, footing detail, ground conditions, temporary versus permanent duration.

scenarios.title: Landscape irrigation system installation
scenarios.scope: Supply and installation of a pop-up and dripline irrigation system to landscaped areas including trenching, laterals, solenoid valves, controller and connection to an existing water supply point.
scenarios.materiality_note: Trenching, valves and controller make this a substantial trade package.
scenarios.research_need: Irrigated area, water supply point, backflow requirements, zoning and controller specification.

scenarios.title: Primary steel framing and purlins
scenarios.scope: Supply, fabrication and erection of primary structural steel framing, purlins and bracing to revised member sizes or spacings within a single-storey portal or framed building.
scenarios.materiality_note: Steel tonnage, fabrication and crane erection are major costs
merges: install structural steel framing to spacing
scenarios.research_need: Member sizes, tonnage, spacing change, crane access and erection duration

scenarios.title: Access platforms and support steel
scenarios.scope: Secondary steelwork for roof access ladders, walkways, maintenance platforms and ceiling or services support framing, including handrails and fixings, within an existing structure.
scenarios.materiality_note: Moderate steel quantity plus working-at-height labour
merges: roof access ladder and walkway installation
scenarios.research_need: Platform area, ladder height, loading, handrail standard and height access method

scenarios.title: Slab redesign and reinforcement change
scenarios.scope: Reinforced concrete floor slab constructed to revised thickness, reinforcement or insulation design, including coldstore slabs, on prepared subgrade in an open area.
scenarios.materiality_note: Concrete volume and steel tonnage change directly with design
merges: reinforced concrete slab construction to revised design
scenarios.research_need: Slab thickness, mesh or bar rate, insulation type and re-design fee

scenarios.title: Polished concrete floor finish
scenarios.scope: Grinding, honing and polishing of existing slab to specified gloss level including densifier, sealer and integral colour or dye application, to open floor areas.
scenarios.materiality_note: Grind passes, densifier and colour dye all carry rate impact.
scenarios.research_need: Grind level, aggregate exposure, gloss level and whether dye/oxide is specified.

scenarios.title: Locker supply and installation
scenarios.scope: Supply and install banks of staff lockers including locks, plinths, end panels and wall noggings or blocking for fixing, in changing or amenity areas.
scenarios.materiality_note: Unit cost per locker plus blocking and lock hardware.
scenarios.research_need: Locker material, tier configuration, lock type and quantity per bank.

scenarios.title: Tenant signage fabrication and installation
scenarios.scope: Fabrication and installation of tenant identification and wayfinding signage including substrate, graphics, fixings and installation access, excluding illuminated signage supply authority work.
scenarios.materiality_note: Fabrication and install access give real per-sign cost.
scenarios.research_need: Sign type, size, illumination, substrate/finish and installation height.

scenarios.title: Distribution board supply and install
scenarios.scope: Supply, mount, wire and label a standard sub-distribution board up to circa 100A with chassis and final circuit breakers, excluding main switchboards.
scenarios.materiality_note: Board, breakers and termination labour are priced items
scenarios.research_need: Board rating, way count, breaker schedule, IP rating and mounting method

scenarios.title: LED high bay luminaire installation
scenarios.scope: Supply and install LED high bay luminaires at warehouse or industrial ceiling heights including suspension, final connection and access equipment.
scenarios.materiality_note: Fitting cost plus elevated work access is significant
merges: supply and install high bay led luminaire
led high bay luminaire supply and install
scenarios.research_need: Luminaire wattage and spec, mounting height, EWP access requirement

scenarios.title: Cladding colour selection change
scenarios.scope: Change of standard colour or finish selection on already specified cladding panels made before fabrication release, with no change to panel type, thickness or fixing.
scenarios.materiality_note: Same panel and labour; standard colour range carries no premium
scenarios.research_need: Whether selected colour sits outside standard range or delays fabrication release

scenarios.title: Drainage point relocation and adjustment
scenarios.scope: Relocate or add a single drainage fixture or connection point with associated pipework up to about 6m, including bend or fall adjustments within an existing in-ground or in-slab run.
scenarios.materiality_note: Breakout, refall and reinstatement cost more than pipe itself
scenarios.research_need: Breakout and reinstatement extent, drainlayer labour rates, fittings and re-testing requirements

scenarios.title: Telecommunications pit installation
scenarios.scope: Supply and install precast telecommunications demarcation/service pits including excavation, bedding, lid, ducting connections and backfill in a trafficked or landscaped area.
scenarios.materiality_note: Precast unit, excavation, ducting and utility coordination all priced
scenarios.research_need: Pit size/class, lid loading rating, duct count, service provider standards and inspection fees

scenarios.title: Sprinkler hydraulic design and calculation
scenarios.scope: Fire engineer and sprinkler designer fees for hydraulic calculations, storage hazard classification and in-rack sprinkler connection design for a single warehouse or storage building.
scenarios.materiality_note: Specialist design fees and hazard reclassification drive rework
merges: sprinkler system design for storage hazard classification
scenarios.research_need: Designer hourly rates, hazard classification scope, in-rack design fee benchmarks

scenarios.title: Fire alarm panel and cabling
scenarios.scope: Supply, install or upgrade a fire alarm control panel including relay, interface and FIP tie-in cabling to building services within one building.
scenarios.materiality_note: Panel hardware plus cabling runs and recommissioning
merges: fire alarm panel replacement or upgrade
scenarios.research_need: Panel type and loop count, cable run lengths, recommissioning and certification cost

scenarios.title: Acoustic baffle ceiling installation
scenarios.scope: Supply and suspend acoustic baffles, blades or rafts from soffit including wires, fixings and setout, to open-plan ceiling areas.
scenarios.materiality_note: Proprietary baffles and access-equipment install are costly items.
scenarios.research_need: Baffle product, size, quantity per m2, suspension height and access method.

scenarios.title: Fan and ductwork installation
scenarios.scope: Supply and install small in-line or roof mounted supply/extract fan with associated galvanised ductwork, flexible connections, dampers and controls wiring for a single system run under 20m.
scenarios.materiality_note: Plant, ductwork and controls all priced together
merges: install extract air fan and ductwork
scenarios.research_need: Fan duty, duct size and length, insulation, acoustic and control requirements

scenarios.title: Relocation of mechanical plant
scenarios.scope: Disconnect, relocate and reconnect existing fans, condensers or similar mechanical plant within the same building including extended pipework, ductwork and power, plus re-commissioning.
scenarios.materiality_note: Double handling, extended services and recommissioning per unit
scenarios.research_need: Unit size, relocation distance, service extension lengths and downtime/access constraints

scenarios.title: Roof fall arrest anchor system
scenarios.scope: Supply, install and certify fall arrest anchor points or static line on an existing roof, including structural fixing and load testing.
scenarios.materiality_note: Certification and structural fixing exceed hardware cost
merges: roof anchor and static line installation
scenarios.research_need: Anchor type, substrate fixing, testing/certification and producer statement cost

scenarios.title: Form ventilation opening in fabric
scenarios.scope: Cut, frame and weatherproof a new ventilation opening through existing wall or roof fabric including lintel/trimming, flashings and make-good, excluding fan and grille.
scenarios.materiality_note: Structural trimming and weathertightness works per opening
merges: form ventilation opening in wall or roof
form wall opening for mechanical plant
scenarios.research_need: Existing fabric type, opening size, structural trimming and weatherproofing detail required

scenarios.title: Settlement monitoring installation and surveys
scenarios.scope: Supply and install settlement plates or monitoring instrumentation with baseline and periodic survey readings over a defined monitoring period.
scenarios.materiality_note: Hardware cheap; repeat survey visits drive the cost
scenarios.research_need: Plate supply and install cost plus surveyor visit rate and monitoring duration

scenarios.title: Earthing system and conductor installation
scenarios.scope: Supply and install main and supplementary earthing conductors, earth electrodes, bonding and associated communications earth cabling within a single building or site.
scenarios.materiality_note: Copper conductor and electrode quantities carry moderate cost
scenarios.research_need: Conductor sizes, electrode counts, AS/NZS 3000 earth resistance test requirements

scenarios.title: Main switchboard and transformer works
scenarios.scope: Supply, install or upgrade a main switchboard and associated transformer, including planned shutdown, changeover and re-energisation of live services.
scenarios.materiality_note: Major plant plus shutdown and out-of-hours labour
scenarios.research_need: Switchboard rating, transformer kVA, shutdown duration and out-of-hours access

scenarios.title: EV charge point installation
scenarios.scope: Supply, mount, cable and commission an AC or DC EV charging unit including dedicated circuit, protection and load management to one bay.
scenarios.materiality_note: Charger unit, submain and commissioning are high value
merges: ev charge point supply and install
scenarios.research_need: Charger kW and make, submain length, load management and network capacity

scenarios.title: Security CCTV and access control
scenarios.scope: Supply, install and commission CCTV cameras, access control readers, door hardware interfaces and detection sensors with associated cabling for one building.
scenarios.materiality_note: Devices, head-end and commissioning are high value
merges: access control and cctv system installation
supply and install security cctv and access control system
scenarios.research_need: Device counts, head-end platform, cabling runs and commissioning hours

scenarios.title: Turf supply and installation
scenarios.scope: Supply and laying of ready lawn or hydroseed over prepared subgrade in open areas including topsoil spreading, fine grading and initial establishment, excluding irrigation and planting beds.
scenarios.materiality_note: Area-driven rate; topsoil import drives most of the cost.
merges: plant and turf supply and installation
scenarios.research_need: Turf type, topsoil depth and import source, area and establishment obligations.

scenarios.title: Stormwater pipe and outlet resizing
scenarios.scope: Change in diameter of stormwater connection, discharge line or tank inlet/outlet opening from tendered size, priced as rate difference plus altered trench, fittings and penetrations.
scenarios.materiality_note: Pipe upsizing changes trench, fittings and bedding cost
scenarios.research_need: Rate differentials per pipe diameter, fitting and tank penetration costs, trench width change

scenarios.title: Underground stormwater tank installation
scenarios.scope: Supply and install buried stormwater detention or storage tank including excavation, bedding, backfill, anti-flotation and inlet/outlet connections, for tanks up to around 30,000 litres.
scenarios.materiality_note: Tank, deep excavation and craneage are significant cost items
merges: underground storage tank supply and installation
scenarios.research_need: Tank supply rates by volume, excavation depth, dewatering, crane and backfill specification

scenarios.title: Slab edge and joint detailing
scenarios.scope: Formation of slab edge rebates, thickened or widened edge beams at penetrations and construction or control joints in a concrete floor slab, priced per linear metre of detail.
scenarios.materiality_note: Extra formwork, bar and joint hardware over modest lengths
merges: edge beam width increase at penetration
scenarios.research_need: Detail length, formwork complexity, dowel or joint product specified

scenarios.title: Fire pump set and testing
scenarios.scope: Supply, install, connect and flow test a diesel or electric fire pump set including controller, excluding pump room building and water storage tank.
scenarios.materiality_note: Major plant item plus witnessed commissioning cost
merges: fire pump set selection and installation
scenarios.research_need: Pump duty and drive type, supplier pricing, witnessed flow test costs

scenarios.title: Fire pump room construction
scenarios.scope: Construct a fire-rated pump room enclosure including slab, walls, roof, doors, ventilation and incoming power, water and drainage service connections, to a single plant room.
scenarios.materiality_note: New structure plus serviced connections, substantial builders work
merges: fire pump room construction and installation
scenarios.research_need: Room size, fire rating, service run distances and local authority requirements

scenarios.title: Fire water storage tank
scenarios.scope: Supply and install a dedicated fire water storage tank with base, inlet, outlet and level controls, sized for sprinkler duration on a single site.
scenarios.materiality_note: Large tank, foundation and connection works, high capital cost
merges: fire water storage tank supply and installation
scenarios.research_need: Required storage volume, tank material, foundation design and site access

scenarios.title: Site water main and meter
scenarios.scope: Supply and installation of buried site water main up to 100mm diameter with water meter assembly and connection to the network authority main, including trench, backfill and disinfection testing within the site boundary.
scenarios.materiality_note: Excavation, authority fees and testing carry substantial cost
merges: water main pipework supply and installation
scenarios.research_need: Pipe diameter and material, main depth, network authority connection and meter fees

scenarios.title: Metal flashing and gutter fabrication
scenarios.scope: Fabrication and installation of folded metal flashings, cappings and gutter trims to an existing roof, standard coated steel up to 0.55mm, excluding full roof sheet replacement.
scenarios.materiality_note: Bespoke folding and labour on height adds real cost
merges: supply and install flashing and guttering finish
scenarios.research_need: Folded girth bands, coating grade, crane/EWP access and jointing method

scenarios.title: Roof access walkway and ladder
scenarios.scope: Supply and install proprietary roof walkway, access ladder and handrail systems fixed to an existing structural roof, excluding structural steel strengthening.
scenarios.materiality_note: Proprietary systems, engineering and height work are costly
merges: roof access ladder and walkway installation
roof access walkway and handrail installation
scenarios.research_need: System type, span, fixing to purlins, PS1 and compliance requirements

scenarios.title: Condensate drainage and tundish
scenarios.scope: Install, connect or reroute condensate drain lines with tundish, trap and fall to nearest waste point within 15m, for air conditioning or refrigeration units.
scenarios.materiality_note: Low material cost but ceiling access labour per unit
scenarios.research_need: Drain run length, available fall, waste point location and ceiling access method

scenarios.title: Coordination of others' installations
scenarios.scope: Main contractor attendance, programming, access and interface coordination for separate contractors installing pallet racking and loading dock equipment during the build.
scenarios.materiality_note: Management time and attendance over weeks, no materials
merges: coordinate dock equipment installation by others
coordinate pallet racking installation by others
coordinate racking and dock equipment installation by others
scenarios.research_need: Attendance weeks, site management hourly rate, scaffold and power attendance scope

scenarios.title: Protective coating to structural elements
scenarios.scope: Application of specified protective coating systems to structural steel and exposed concrete surfaces, including surface preparation, priced per coated square metre.
scenarios.materiality_note: Preparation and multi-coat systems add cost beyond base paint
merges: protective coating application to structural steel
protective coating application to steel and concrete
protective coating application to pergola and exits
scenarios.research_need: Coating system, durability class, surface area, shop versus site application

scenarios.title: Geotechnical testing and compaction certification
scenarios.scope: Additional in-situ and laboratory earthworks testing (NDM, CBR, Scala, proof rolling) with engineer's compaction certification for a defined fill area.
scenarios.materiality_note: Testing fees plus standby time add up on staged fills
scenarios.research_need: Typical NZ lab and field test unit rates plus engineer certification fees

scenarios.title: Exterior window and door joinery
scenarios.scope: Supply and install exterior aluminium window and door units into prepared openings, including flashings and sealing, priced per m2 of joinery for standard commercial suites.
scenarios.materiality_note: Glazing suite, IGU spec and flashings drive significant cost
merges: door and window supply and installation
scenarios.research_need: Suite and glazing spec rates per m2, flashing and sealing allowances

scenarios.title: Kitchen and bathroom fixture fitout
scenarios.scope: Supply and install kitchen and bathroom fixtures and cabinetry handles to completed joinery units, excluding plumbing and electrical connections.
scenarios.materiality_note: Fixture supply cost varies; install labour modest per item
merges: supply and install kitchen and bathroom fixtures
scenarios.research_need: Fixture and handle supply rates by grade, fitting labour per item

scenarios.title: Lighting control system upgrade
scenarios.scope: Supply, install and commission lighting control gear (sensors, daylight dimming, DALI/relay controllers) added to existing or new luminaire circuits to meet compliance.
scenarios.materiality_note: Control gear, cabling and commissioning are significant added cost

scenarios.title: Refrigeration pipework termination
scenarios.scope: Terminate and connect insulated refrigeration pipework to cabinets or plant including brazing, pressure test, evacuation and gas charge, per termination point.
scenarios.materiality_note: Specialist refrigeration labour and gas charge per point
scenarios.research_need: Refrigerant type, pipe sizes, insulation and certified technician rates per termination

scenarios.title: Glycol circulation pump installation
scenarios.scope: Supply and install glycol circulation pump set with isolation valves, flexible connections, strainer and power/control connection to existing glycol circuit.
scenarios.materiality_note: Packaged pump plus connections is significant plant cost
merges: supply and install glycol circulation pump
scenarios.research_need: Pump duty, glycol concentration, control interface and available power supply

scenarios.title: Material laydown area establishment
scenarios.scope: Forming, surfacing and reinstating a hardstand material storage and laydown area within the site boundary, excluding fencing and site offices.
scenarios.materiality_note: Hardstand metalling and reinstatement carries measurable cost
scenarios.research_need: Area required, GAP metal depth, geotextile, and reinstatement obligation

scenarios.title: Site safety signage and marking
scenarios.scope: Supply and install assembly point signage, directional and hazard signs with associated ground marking for the construction site.
scenarios.materiality_note: Few low-cost signs, minimal labour content
merges: site assembly point signage and marking
scenarios.research_need: Sign count, sizes, mounting method and whether H&S plan mandates them

scenarios.title: Contract insurance endorsement amendment
scenarios.scope: Amending or endorsing contract works, public liability or professional indemnity cover to meet a changed client requirement, priced as premium adjustment plus broker fee.
scenarios.materiality_note: Premium uplift varies with sum insured and cover change
scenarios.research_need: Broker fee plus premium rate percentage for cover type and sum insured

scenarios.title: Client-supplied goods handling installation
scenarios.scope: Receiving, unloading, storing, protecting and installing free-issue client-supplied items, excluding the cost of the goods themselves and any warranty risk.
scenarios.materiality_note: Labour, plant and storage real but goods cost excluded
merges: handling and installation of client-supplied goods
scenarios.research_need: Item weights, delivery programme, storage duration and craneage or handling plant

scenarios.title: Engineering review of product substitutions
scenarios.scope: Structural and fire engineer hours to assess a proposed product or system substitution, re-issue calculations and PS1/PS4 documentation, excluding any redesign of the base building.
scenarios.materiality_note: Chargeable engineer hours plus producer statement reissue fees
merges: structural and fire design review for substitutions
scenarios.research_need: Current NZ structural and fire engineer hourly rates and PS1 reissue fee ranges

scenarios.title: Evacuation scheme design and approval
scenarios.scope: Preparation of a building evacuation scheme, trial evacuation documentation and lodgement with Fire and Emergency NZ for approval, for a single building.
scenarios.materiality_note: Fixed consultant fee plus statutory lodgement, modest but real
scenarios.research_need: Fire consultant fee for evacuation scheme and FENZ approval lodgement costs

scenarios.title: Quality assurance software licensing
scenarios.scope: Per-user subscription licences for site quality assurance and ITP software over the construction period, excluding hardware and configuration labour.
scenarios.materiality_note: Per-seat monthly fees over long programmes accumulate
scenarios.research_need: Typical per-user monthly licence rates and seat counts for NZ site QA platforms

scenarios.title: Vehicle boom gate installation
scenarios.scope: Supply and install a single motorised boom gate barrier with controller, loop detector and power/data connection to an existing paved access point.
scenarios.materiality_note: Proprietary hardware, power, controls and commissioning all add cost.
scenarios.research_need: Boom arm length, access control interface, power/data availability, commissioning requirements

scenarios.title: Insulated panel thermal specification upgrade
scenarios.scope: Change of insulated sandwich panel core thickness or type to meet a revised design temperature, priced as a rate difference over the tendered panel across walls and ceiling.
scenarios.materiality_note: Panel rate delta is real but fixings and labour largely unchanged.
merges: adjust insulated panel specification for design temperature
scenarios.research_need: Panel thickness/core options, R-value required, rate delta, flashing and fixing implications

scenarios.title: Licensed asbestos removal and disposal
scenarios.scope: Licensed removal, containment, air monitoring, clearance certification and approved landfill disposal of identified asbestos-containing material in an existing building.
scenarios.materiality_note: Licensed trade, containment, monitoring and special disposal are costly.
scenarios.research_need: ACM type and friability, area, access, WorkSafe notification, clearance and disposal rates
